ownerReview.customHtml: Not one of the eight criteria. Custom HTML is disabled by default in the Player (D36); running it (trusted) needs an explicit decision of the host; the Player does not guarantee network isolation; the Producer keeps --network none. The pinned tests "runs no Custom HTML without the host opt-in" and "trusts the Custom HTML of the reference fixture explicitly" passed in this run, and so did the three rows of D42.6 that hide a Custom HTML frame: on the runner too, the acknowledgement and the presentation barrier completed while the frame was hidden (D42.4). custom-html-probes.json of the artifact (not carried here) shows the WebRTC probe gathering one mDNS host candidate on the runner, which has a network interface (eth0); the local pinned run of the same tree, without a network, gathered none (D28.9, D36). The parity environment of the run had eth0, while the committed parity record was measured loopback-only; parity was 0/0 on every frame in both.
